part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"Redirect compute from more molecules to a chemistry-conditioned correction: regress MD-to-measurement residuals on cheap per-molecule descriptors (carbon number, ester-group count, MD-predicted value) trained on a modest set and validated held-out.","reason":"Compute trains a transferable residual-correction model instead of resampling the same bias; it buys error reduction across all 835 molecules."},{"index":2,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"Change the measured quantity to a cheaper related one that converges in about 1 ns, such as the self-diffusion coefficient from the mean-squared displacement, combined through a Stokes–Einstein- or Rosenfeld-style scaling with density and size, calibrated to viscosity on a small anchor set.","reason":"Replaces slow Green–Kubo viscosity with a fast diffusion-derived proxy; compute then buys chemical coverage rather than trajectory length."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"NA","quote":"Reorder the work: at the 24-molecule stage, decompose per-replica percent errors into between-molecule and within-molecule variance, then let that decomposition choose the allocation.","reason":"Computes a new variance decomposition that adaptively steers remaining budget to coverage or longer replicas — runs the fixed plan never bought."}]}
